mapper.sql: id, sub_order_no, master_id, warehouse_id, amount, send_type, from_warehouse_id, status, delivery_type, express_no, driver_phone, delivery_remark, expect_send_date, actual_send_date, picker_user_id, remark, is_delete
mapper.select: SELECT MAX(sub_order_no) FROM order_sub WHERE master_id = #{masterId} AND sub_order_no LIKE CONCAT(#{subOrderPrefix}, '%')

SELECT os.id, os.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, w.warehouse_name AS warehouseName, os.amount, os.delivery_type AS deliveryType, os.delivery_remark AS deliveryRemark, DATE_FORMAT(os.expect_send_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS expectSendDate FROM order_sub os LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON os.warehouse_id = w.id WHERE os.master_id = #{masterId} AND os.is_delete = 0 ORDER BY os.sub_order_no ASC

SELECT os.id, om.order_no AS orderNo, os.sub_order_no AS subOrderNo, c.name AS customerName, w.warehouse_name AS warehouseName, os.delivery_type AS deliveryType, os.status, DATE_FORMAT(os.expect_send_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS expectSendDate, DATE_FORMAT(os.actual_send_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS actualSendDate, os.picker_user_id AS pickerUserId, os.express_no AS expressNo, os.delivery_remark AS deliveryRemark, os.remark, os.amount FROM order_sub os INNER JOIN order_master om ON os.master_id = om.id LEFT JOIN customer c ON om.customer_id = c.id LEFT JOIN warehouse w ON os.warehouse_id = w.id AND w.is_delete = 0 WHERE os.id = #{subId} AND os.is_delete = 0
